caveats: No civil lawsuit had actually been filed as of the sources (both published 2025-10-02): the 22-year-old formerly incarcerated woman filed a tort claim in September 2025 (a precursor/notice required before suing) seeking at least $300,000 against the county over former jail deputy Devon Larsen groping and forcibly kissing her in her cell. lawsuit_type 'civilian' is the closest fit (incarcerated civilian vs. jail deputy); year_filed is null because only the tort claim, not a suit, is documented. Larsen pleaded guilty April 2025 to two misdemeanor counts of sexual battery; sentenced May 2025 to 2 years supervised probation, 20 days jail, 20 days labor detail; POST-decertified July 2025.
